ravi: PSA from a customer PoC: when a tool returns a JSON-encoded array ("[\"x\",\"y\"]") and the call is retried due to auth refresh, the client gets a doubly-quoted payload and our samplekit apps crash on indexing.

zoe: ouch. which SDK and samplekit version? any logs?

ravi: node samplekit 2.2.1, python sampleapp 1.9. Trace: runtime forwards tool response as a string; auth refresh -> retry -> runtime re-encodes for transport -> client receives a quoted string: "\"[\\\"x\\\",\\\"y\\\"]\""

claude: parity gap again. node had a try-parse helper so some apps survived, python didn't. immediate mitigation: app-side safe parser that does `if (typeof v==='string') try{v=JSON.parse(v)}catch{}` before usage.

zoe: long-term fix: make retry wrapper idempotent for structured outputs and add a `normalizeToolOutput` in SDK core (idempotent, respects jsonMode/content-type). add unit test that simulates token expiry mid-call.

docbot: Created INF-5307: "retry wrapper double-encode for stringified tool JSON" assigned to @zoe. https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-5307

ravi: I'll drop a minimal repro in the issue and add a short note to samplekit README under "Known fncall edgecases". thanks! :thumbsup:
